title: Kanda 10: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 10.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 10.

verses.original: कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठति भूमिरेतस्मिन् कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठत्यन्तरिक्षम् । कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठत्याहिता द्यौः कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठत्युत्तरं दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhati bhūmiretasmin kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhatyantarikṣam | kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhatyāhitā dyauḥ kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhatyuttaraṁ divaḥ ||
verses.translation: In which limb of this Supreme Pillar rests the earth? In which limb is the atmosphere established? In which limb is the sky upheld, and the realms beyond heaven?

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Skambha hymn: contemplating Brahman as the infinite cosmic Pillar supporting all existence.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: In which limb of this Supreme Pillar rests the earth? In which limb is the atmosphere established? In which limb is the sky upheld, and the realms beyond heaven?

layers.content: अथर्ववेद काण्ड 10: The Skambha hymn: contemplating Brahman as the infinite cosmic Pillar supporting all existence.
